name: rhProject sync wiki index
description: 按 schedule 在 rhProject 根目录执行 npm run sync:wiki，更新 .cursor/wiki/GENERATED-INDEX.md（Qoder Repowiki 索引）。

prompts.prompt:
You are maintaining the rhProject monorepo wiki index.

1. Ensure the workspace root is rhProject (monorepo with wk-train-center-service, wk-train-center-ui, .cursor/wiki).
2. Run: npm run sync:wiki
3. Confirm success by reading the last 5 lines of .cursor/wiki/GENERATED-INDEX.md — expect a line like **合计**：397 篇 (count may vary).
4. If the command fails, report stderr and whether .qoder/repowiki paths exist.
5. Do not regenerate Repowiki in Qoder; only sync the index from existing repowiki files.
6. Reply briefly: timestamp, total count, and whether GENERATED-INDEX was updated.
